newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Pica debuts at 3.70 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Pica debuts at 3.70 ringgit.

text.p: Venture capital company Pica (M) Corp Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Tuesday at 3.70 ringgit, compared with a 1.90 ringgit offer price.
At 0135 GMT, the stock was trading at 3.60 ringgit after more than 1.3 million shares changed hands.
The company, which listed on the Main Board, offered 14.2 million shares to the public.
Pica's business activities include equity investment, mezzanine capital and equity financing, financial advisory services and securities trading.

For the year ended December 31, 1995, the company made a pre-tax profit of 13.9 million ringgit, against 9.3 million in the previous year. Pica posted a pre-tax profit of 13.6 million ringgit in the first half of this year.
